comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop; PR-312 replaces a ratchet-dispenser cartridge and restores the tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Concentric countertorque differs from rod retraction, cartridge extraction/insertion, pawl re-engagement, and cradle placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained angle over cycles; PR-312 checks used-cartridge collection, replacement seating, rod engagement, and released clearance.
comparison.reason: The ratchet task tests component replacement and mechanism restoration, not preservation of an adjusted setting while locking.
